Fur Baby is amazing all around! I’ve been bringing Koda here since they first opened, and I honestly can’t say enough good things about this place. From the receptionists to the groomers, everyone has always been wonderful, accommodating, and genuinely caring.

They’ve always done their best to work Koda into the schedule, even sometimes getting him in the same day. They also offer services like deep dental cleanings without anesthesia.

Koda is a Goldendoodle, and they consistently do an amazing job grooming him. He always comes home looking exactly how I want him—fluffy, rounded, and like the perfect little teddy bear. I also LOVE the products they use. They have a distinctive finishing spray that smells so good that I actually bought it to use at home!

What I appreciate most is how they treat Koda. He normally gets very nervous going to the groomer, but I’ve noticed such a difference when he comes here. There have unfortunately been a couple of times when I brought him in with more knots than I’m proud of, and they were never judgmental. Instead, they were understanding, took their time working through them, and even gave him breaks when needed so he wouldn’t become overwhelmed.

Sadly, I moved farther away and had to start looking for a groomer closer to home, which is the ONLY reason I stopped coming regularly. Honestly, I may just make the 50-minute drive because finding a place you completely trust with your dog is worth it.
Excellent service

They did a great job with my handsome English cocker spaniel, Buddy. Even gave him a cute man bun to go with his fresh cut. He has sensitive skin and I asked them to use his special medicated shampoo which they did as requested. He came back happy and refreshed. Definitely will come back again.

I’ve never left a review for any business in my life, but I can’t let this one slide
I’ve had ongoing issues here. Pricing changes every time I come anywhere from $90 to $160 for the same service, with no explanation. On a previous visit, my dog’s collar went missing, and I got no call, no apology just a piece of tape around his neck when I picked him up.

Today was the worst. I dropped my dog off at 11am for a bath and was told I’d get a call once he was ready. By 4:30pm supposedly still 6 hours into a bath  I’d heard nothing, so I called and was told he still wasn’t ready. I went in person immediately and if I hadn’t, I’m convinced they would have just left him there, locked up and crying. When I arrived, I was suddenly told he’d been ready for a time. When I asked why no one called, staff said they “I forgot” amd “I don’t have time”.

While I was there, I could hear my dog crying from the back room. He’s normally very playful, but ever since I picked him up, he’s been pretty quiet and still.

I won’t be returning, and I’d think twice before bringing your pet here. 💔

Today, I took my golden doodle to Fur Baby Spaw for a haircut. I had given the manager and groomers specific instructions, requesting that he resemble a teddy bear and avoid a rat-like appearance. I also indicated the only area on his body where he had mats in his hair. The groomers informed me that removing the mats would require an additional hour. I agreed and left him there. Subsequently, they contacted me, stating that while removing the mats, the dog was becoming stressed. We inquired if they could trim the hair around the neck. The groomer responded that the dog would look horrible. We provided them with clear instructions to trim the hair only around the neck and refrain from shaving him down completely. Upon picking him up, I observed that they had not adhered to our instructions and had shaved him down entirely, disregarding our request to trim the hair only around the neck. This will be the final time I will visit this establishment and pay hundreds of dollars to have my dog look like a rat.
